'''Ross Arok''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Massachusetts State Championship]] on 14 April 2001 with EBO Mon Cals, according to Mike Gemme's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2091">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-16-8-is-great-at-ma-states-deck-steebod2091/ 8-is-great-at-ma-states-deck-steebo], DeckTech (michael "Deck" Gemme, 16 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-16-8-is-great-at-ma-states-deck-steebod2091/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
